extracted.name: Cucumber Slaw
extracted.description: Cucumber slaw with carrots and onion is made with a light vinegar-based dressing that is quick and easy to prepare.
ingredient_lines: 2 cucumbers - quartered, seeded, and thinly sliced
instruction_lines: Combine cucumbers, carrots, onion, sugar, coriander, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl; add vinegar and mix well.
